An attempted diagram edit does not produce a verified replacement. The work stops before approval, so there is no comparable completed baseline.
sessions.decision: Reject publication. Record the unequal-whole error and require a corrected diagram plus review of dependent feedback before any lesson use.

sessions.event: Owen declines another product session. The scenario supplies no verified resolution of the day-4 error. No new task or timing occurs.
sessions.decision: Use the reviewed school material for the next lesson. Do not count the declined session as zero effort or a completed comparison.

sessions.event: Owen declines the final imagined product session. His day-4 error report remains the reason for refusal. No new mathematics inspection occurs.
sessions.decision: Keep the existing task bank until a reviewed correction and a repeatable review process are demonstrated.

stated_preference: The full preview is useful, but a known reviewed task is preferable when the draft contains an unresolved mathematical error.
week_two_reason: No completed imagined session occurs on day 8 or day 12. Owen declines because the assigned unequal-whole defect has no verified resolution in this scenario.
